situations.title: 채혈 전 환자 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm your name and date of birth before I draw blood.
situations.brief: 채혈 전 이름·생년월일로 환자를 2인 확인하고 절차를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?
I'm going to draw a small tube of blood.
You'll feel a quick pinch, then it's over.

situations.title: 정맥로 확보 안내
situations.tagline: I'm placing a small tube in your vein for your fluids.
situations.brief: 정맥로 삽입 과정과 따끔함을 설명하며 긴장한 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: This little tube lets us give you fluids and medicine.
You'll feel a sharp pinch for just a second.
Try to hold your arm nice and still for me.

situations.title: 소변 검체 채취 안내
situations.tagline: We need a clean, mid-stream urine sample.
situations.brief: 중간뇨 청결채취 방법을 환자에게 단계별로 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: First wipe from front to back with this cloth.
Start urinating, then catch the middle part in the cup.
Leave the sample here and I'll take care of it.

situations.title: 심전도 부착 설명
situations.tagline: These stickers read your heart — just hold still.
situations.brief: 심전도 전극 부착 과정을 설명하고 움직임 자제를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm placing these stickers to check your heart.
It doesn't hurt at all — it just listens.
Please stay still for about ten seconds.
goals: 정확한 측정을 위해 움직임 자제를 유도한다

situations.title: 검사 목적 설명
situations.tagline: Let me explain why we're running these tests.
situations.brief: 시행할 검사의 필요성과 목적을 설명해 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: These tests help us find what's causing your pain.
It's a routine step to keep you safe.
I'll let you know as soon as we have results.

situations.title: 어려운 정맥 확보
situations.tagline: Your veins are tricky today — let me try another way.
situations.brief: 정맥로 확보에 반복 실패한 상황에서 환자를 안심시키고 대안을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm sorry this is taking a few tries.
Your veins are hard to see, so I'll use a warm pack.
If needed, I'll ask a colleague who's great at this.

situations.title: 소아 채혈 협조 유도
situations.tagline: We'll make the blood draw quick and easy for him.
situations.brief: 채혈을 겁내는 아동과 부모를 진정시키며 협조를 유도하세요.
keyPhrases: You can hold him on your lap to keep him calm.
We'll count to three together and it's done.
A sticker and a big high-five are waiting after.

situations.title: 조영제 검사 사전 확인
situations.tagline: Before the CT, I need to check a few things.
situations.brief: 조영제 검사 전 알레르기·신기능·금기 사항을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you ever reacted to contrast dye before?
Do you have any kidney problems or take metformin?
The dye may feel warm — that's normal.
goals: 검사 중 정상 감각을 미리 안내한다

situations.title: 배양검사 무균 채취
situations.tagline: We need to draw this without any contamination.
situations.brief: 배양검사 무균 채취의 이유와 협조 사항을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I need to clean the site really well first.
Please try not to touch the area once it's prepped.
This keeps the sample clean so results are accurate.

situations.title: 항생제 첫 투여 설명
situations.tagline: This is your first dose — tell me right away if you feel odd.
situations.brief: 첫 항생제 투여 전 알레르기를 확인하고 반응 감시를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you had this antibiotic before?
Tell me right away if you feel itchy or short of breath.
I'll be watching you closely during the first dose.
goals: 초기 반응 증상과 감시 계획을 설명한다

situations.title: 수혈 전 확인·설명
situations.tagline: Let's confirm your blood type before we start.
situations.brief: 수혈 전 혈액형·환자 확인을 하고 반응 관찰 방법을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Two of us will double-check your name and blood type.
Tell me if you feel chills, itching, or back pain.
The first fifteen minutes we'll watch you very closely.
goals: 수혈 반응 증상과 관찰 계획을 설명한다

situations.title: 비위관 삽입 협조
situations.tagline: When I say swallow, take a sip and swallow hard.
situations.brief: 비위관 삽입 시 삼킴 유도와 불편감을 설명하며 협조를 이끄세요.
keyPhrases: This tube goes through your nose into your stomach.
When I say go, swallow the water to help it down.
It feels strange, but it won't stop you breathing.

situations.title: 도뇨관 삽입 설명
situations.tagline: This catheter will help drain your bladder.
situations.brief: 도뇨관 삽입 절차와 감염 예방을 설명하고 동의를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: This soft tube drains the urine that's stuck.
I'll clean everything carefully to prevent infection.
It's uncomfortable for a moment, then the pressure eases.

situations.title: 검체 라벨·추적
situations.tagline: Let's confirm your name on every one of these labels.
situations.brief: 다검체 채취 시 환자 확인과 정확한 라벨링·추적을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm labeling each tube with your name right at your bedside.
Can you confirm your date of birth once more?
This makes sure your results never get mixed up.

situations.title: 중심정맥관 삽입 보조
situations.tagline: The doctor will place a deeper line — I'm right here.
situations.brief: 중심정맥관 삽입 중 무균·체위·모니터링을 관리하며 깨어 있는 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: Please keep your head turned to this side.
You'll feel some numbing medicine, then pressure.
The drapes keep everything sterile — try not to touch them.

situations.title: 수혈 반응 발생
situations.tagline: I'm stopping the transfusion right now — you're having a reaction.
situations.brief: 급성 수혈 반응이 발생한 환자에게 즉각 중단을 알리고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm stopping the blood right away.
Tell me exactly what you're feeling now.
We're switching to fluids and calling the doctor.

situations.title: 조영제 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: You're reacting to the dye — we're acting now.
situations.brief: 검사 중 발생한 조영제 아나필락시스에 응급 대응하며 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: You're having a reaction to the contrast.
We're giving epinephrine to open your airway.
Focus on my voice and try to breathe slowly.

situations.title: 골내주사(IO) 응급 확보
situations.tagline: We couldn't find a vein, so we're using the bone route.
situations.brief: 혈관 확보 실패로 골내주사를 시행하는 쇼크 환자에게 신속히 설명하며 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We're placing a line in your leg bone to give medicine fast.
You'll feel strong pressure — it means it's working.
Stay with me, we're getting fluids into you now.
goals: 혈관 실패 시 골내 경로를 신속히 확보한다

situations.title: 응급 약물 오류 방지
situations.tagline: Let's double-check this high-risk drug together.
situations.brief: 고위험 약물 투여 전 동료 간호사와 이중확인을 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you verify the drug, dose, and concentration with me?
Right patient, right route — let's read it aloud.
I calculated fifteen units; can you confirm?

situations.title: 흉관 삽입 보조·통증
situations.tagline: The doctor is placing a chest tube — I'll manage your pain.
situations.brief: 흉관 삽입 중 진통·안정을 제공하며 침습적 절차를 겪는 환자를 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: You'll feel numbing medicine, then pushing pressure.
Squeeze my hand — I'm giving you pain medicine now.
This tube helps your lung expand and you'll breathe easier.

situations.title: 대량수혈 프로토콜
situations.tagline: We're activating massive transfusion — what's the ratio?
situations.brief: 대량출혈 상황에서 당직의와 다중 혈액제제 투여를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm hanging the first unit of packed cells now.
Do you want one-to-one-to-one ratio with plasma and platelets?
Blood bank has two more coolers on the way.
goals: 투여 현황과 도착 상태를 명확히 보고한다
